aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Mexico at 85.05% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 5.59%, followed by macOS at 4.72%.

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
